 PENTAGON to visit Manila for 10th anniversary tour in November
 Photo by: @CUBE_PTG (X) 
 By Kristine Kang 
 Published October 27, 2026 6:47 PM PHT 
 Scroll / Slideshow 
 Photo Inside Page
 Photos 
 K-pop group PENTAGON sets to shine on the Philippine stage once again as they prepare to visit the country this year.
 The group recently announced additional stops for their 10th Anniversary Tour “101010” on their official social media pages.
 Filipino UNIVERSE (the group's official fandom) can rejoice as Manila was included in the exciting list of destinations.
 The Manila stop is scheduled for November 29. Further details, including the venue and ticket-selling information, will be announced soon.
 READ: PENTAGON reveals what they remember most about the Philippines on 'Behind The Song Podcast' 
 "After 10 incredible years, the wait is finally over! PENTAGON is bringing their FIRST-EVER SOLO CONCERT IN MANILA as part of their PENTAGON 10th Anniversary Tour 101010," Show Biz Town wrote in a post.
 Meanwhile, PENTAGON is also set to visit Taipei on December 27.
 [🛎️] PENTAGON 10th Anniversary Tour <101010> 추가 일정 안내 [Manila] 📅 2026.11.29 [Taipei] 📅 2026.12.27 * 본 투어에 대한 자세한 소식은 각 지역 프로모터 페이지를 통해 안내될 예정입니다. * Follow mentioned tour promoters for more info. #펜타곤 #PENTAGON #PENTAGON_101010 #PENTAGON_10th_Anniversary
— PENTAGON·펜타곤 (@CUBE_PTG) October 27, 2026 
 PENTAGON is a South Korean boy group formed through Mnet's survival show Pentagon Maker . The group debuted on October 10, 2016, under Cube Entertainment.
 They are known for songs such as “Shine,” “Humph!,” “Naughty Boy,” and “Daisy.”
 LOOK: PENTAGON drops concept photos for album 'IN:VITE U' 
 The group last performed in the Philippines in 2022 at the Halloween-themed K-pop concert Hallyuween .
 In 2023, the members began focusing on their individual careers. However, they reunited earlier this year to celebrate their 10th anniversary.
 Despite the reunion, only seven members are reportedly set to participate in the anniversary concert tour.
